description: This file manages agent event states, including registration, retrieval, emission, and resetting of agent events and contexts, utilizing global singleton pattern and event listeners.

methods.name: getAgentEventState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the global agent event state singleton.

methods.name: registerAgentRunContext
methods.description: Registers or updates the context for a specific agent run identified by runId.

methods.name: getAgentRunContext
methods.description: Fetches the context for a specific agent run by runId.

methods.name: clearAgentRunContext
methods.description: Deletes the context for a specific agent run.

methods.name: resetAgentRunContextForTest
methods.description: Clears all agent run contexts, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: emitAgentEvent
methods.description: Emits an agent event, assigning sequence number and timestamp, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: onAgentEvent
methods.description: Registers a listener for agent events.

methods.name: resetAgentEventsForTest
methods.description: Resets all agent event states and listeners, primarily for testing.
